title: Throw Food for Animals
description: Throw food to discover animals, train to reach new habitats, and grow a collection of pets that earn for you.

title: Forge Beyond
description: Train your hero, battle dungeons, and forge powerful gear. Collect pets, unlock race powers, and master swords, hammers, and gauntlets as you journey through new Worlds.

title: Frozen Sea Fish Factory
description: Draw ice loops on the sea to freeze fish, haul the blocks to your factory and grow it into a frozen fishing empire!

title: Zoo Zen
description: Stroll a vibrant low-poly 3D zoo with lakes, bridges and mountains. Snap photos of lions, pandas, penguins and more to complete your wildlife album! 📸🦁

title: Minecraft Creative: Cats & Food Update
description: Build anything in a blocky world! Tame colorful cats, cook steak, craft & smelt, fill buckets, write books, customize your character, enchant gear & wire redstone!

title: Natural Disaster Survival
description: Survive 12 natural disasters on 10 island maps! Tornadoes, tsunamis, meteors and more destroy everything. Outlast the bots, earn coins, and top the survival leaderboard.

title: Mecha Clash
description: Red vs blue giant mechs on the Moon. Pick a mech, push three canyon lanes with minion waves, break the towers, upgrade in the shop and destroy the enemy base!

title: Zombies vs Humans with Guns
description: #action #adventure #creative #survival #horror

title: Train To Gain
description: Go from skinny to LEGEND! 💪 Lift, run, swim, box bosses and flex on stage in a colourful 3D gym — hatch buddies, spin for prizes and climb the leaderboard!

title: Mecha Arm +1
description: Race and climb, collect all differents mecha arms

title: Lakeside Egg Thief
description: Steal eggs from sleeping guardians across 13 lakeside biomes, hatch them in your pen, fish for eggs and pearls, and outrun rival thieves.

title: Titan Transformer
description: Morph a colossal mech into a truck, sports car, tank, helicopter or fighter jet. Roam an endless 3D world and storm enemy kingdoms — or just explore.

title: Steal an Egg
description: Sneak. Steal. Hatch. Get fast! Steal eggs from sleeping guardians, outrun them home and hatch rare pets.

title: Ben 10: Ultimate Aliens
description: Go Ultimate in Bellwood! Transform into Humungousaur, Swampfire, Big Chill, Echo Echo and many more, evolve them into their Ultimate forms and battle Vilgax, Albedo and Aggregor.

title: Steal an Egg Monster
description: Steal monster eggs, escape giant guardians, train your speed and hatch T-Rex, megalodon and other monsters in your pen. A spooky 3D adventure with six lively rivals.

title: Frost Harbor: Ice Fishing Tycoon
description: Spear fish through the ice, cook and sell them, hire workers, shoo away cheeky polar bears and grow a frozen fishing village into a bustling harbor.

title: EGG HEIST TYCOON
description: Sneak into jungle dens as a soft-voxel courier, snatch giant golden eggs from sleeping guardians, outrun them home and hatch a money-making pet farm!

title: FISHMART MASTER
description:
Explore a peaceful, bioluminescent forest where you can tap glowing mushrooms to trigger soothing musical notes and watch the garden respond with pulses of light and color. It is a gentle, interactive soundscape designed for rhythmic play and visual relaxation.


• Procedural, interactive musical harmonies created by your taps.
• A fully reactive, glowing environment that changes based on your touch.

title: Demolition Derpy
description: Navigate a chaotic arena in a wobbly, physics-driven vehicle to bump into rivals and be the last car standing.

title: Slap and steal a car
description: Steal epic cars, slap your rivals, build your dream car dealership, and become the richest player in Slap and Steal a Car!

title: Parking City: Prank Simulator
description: Explore a lively voxel city, pull hilarious poop, water and fake-spider pranks, surprise NPCs, escape angry crowds, drive cars and bikes, fly as a bird, play with a dog, and enjoy a chaotic open world
